sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Blank-Check Entity for Public Market Acquisition Mergers (SPAC)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act (公司法), Art. 2(1) Type 2 (Limited Company), Arts. 98-112 (limited-company establishment), Art. 128 (incorporator share subscription), Art. 387 (registration), Art. 388 (examination and rectification); Company Registration and Administration Act (公司登记及认许办法), Arts. 5-8; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals (外国人投资条例), Arts. 3, 6-9; Regulations Governing the Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland Area People (大陆地区人民来台投资许可办法), Arts. 4-6; Regulations Governing Verification of Paid-in Capital (公司申请登记资本额查核办法); Securities and Exchange Act (证券交易法), Art. 22; Taipei Exchange Rules Governing Initial Public Offerings of Special Purpose Acquisition Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Administration of Commerce (商业署), Company Registration and One-Stop Service Division.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Registration Application (公司设立登记申请书) filed electronically on the MOEA Company Registration One-Stop Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a limited company under the Companies Act; the full stated capital must be remitted in cash before filing, deposited in a bank settlement account, and verified by a licensed CPA by bank capital certificate. SPAC-specific rule: Taipei Exchange requires the IPO trust/escrow balance of raised funds to be at least NT$300,000,000 (approx. USD 9,300,000), with sponsor shares segregated in custody escrow.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST ORGANIZATIONAL (BOARD) RESOLUTION - [WFOE] TAIWAN CO., LTD. Adopted by the sole incorporator to effect the statutory incorporation: 1. SUBSCRIPTIONS AND CAPITAL. The entire paid-in capital has been subscribed and fully remitted through the designated bank settlement account, verified by the licensed CPA and reserved for the SPAC trust fund. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office is established at [address]; MOEA Administration of Commerce filing, name reservation, and tax registration are authorized. 3. APPOINTMENTS. [Name] is appointed as sole director and responsible person; [Name] as general manager; [Name] as AML compliance officer; each is authorized to execute filings, open bank, custody, and escrow accounts, and complete FSC/TPEx SPAC licensing. Certified on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Administration of Commerce - Online One-Stop Company Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Company Name and Business Scope Pre-approval Application (公司名称及营业项目预先查核申请书) through the MOEA portal, specifying the Chinese and English company names and the ISIC 6499 SPAC business scope. Pay the NT$300 name-review fee and obtain the pre-approval certificate, which is valid for six months.
required_dossiers: Pre-approval application form
Shareholder or board resolution of the foreign investor
Power of attorney authorizing the local responsible person
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, file a new pre-approval with a modified name under Article 17 of the Company Registration and Administration Act; no penalty, only re-filing required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Mainland-Investor Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (经济部投资审议委员会)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Application for Approval of Foreign Investment together with the mainland-investor screening questionnaire, since the ultimate parent is a People's Republic of China company, and the investment is subject to the Regulations Governing the Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland Area People. Provide the SPAC business plan, sponsor background, trust-escrow structure, and proposed articles of association. Pay the NT$5,000 examination fee and obtain the Investment Approval Letter before incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Foreign investor certificate of incorporation and articles of association
Latest audited financial statements of the foreign investor
SPAC investment plan, target acquisition pipeline, and trust-custody agreement
Proposed articles of association of the Taiwan company
Power of attorney and identification of the local responsible person
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a deficiency notice is issued, supplement notarized or legalized documents within 30 days; if the industry is on the negative list, amend the investment plan or file an administrative appeal under the Administrative Appeal Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Capital Account Opening and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated Foreign-Exchange Bank and Licensed Certified Public Accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary foreign-currency settlement account in the prospective company's name and obtain inward remittance of the approved paid-in capital via SWIFT. After clearing, obtain a Bank Capital Deposit Certificate and instruct a licensed CPA to perform the statutory capital verification and issue the Capital Verification Report (资本额查核报告书) per the Regulations Governing Verification of Paid-in Capital.
required_dossiers: Investment Approval Letter from the Investment Commission
SWIFT MT103 remittance voucher
Bank capital deposit certificate
CPA capital verification report
Share subscription statement and no-capital-withdrawal undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If remittance records are incomplete or returned, obtain a corrected SWIFT/crediting advice and re-issue the CPA report; if funds are short, arrange a supplementary remittance before the registration filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Administration of Commerce - One-Stop Registration Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Company Incorporation Registration Application (公司设立登记申请书) on the MOEA electronic filing system, attaching the incorporation resolutions, Investment Approval Letter, CPA capital verification report, bank certificate, articles of association, and registered-office proof. Execute the responsible person's electronic signature and pay the registration fee. Upon approval, the MOEA issues the Company Registration Certificate.
required_dossiers: Company incorporation registration application form
Articles of association of the Taiwan limited company
Investment Commission approval letter
CPA capital verification report and bank capital certificate
Proof of registered office (lease contract and building-use license)
Copy of the foreign investor's certificate of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a rectification notice under Article 388 of the Companies Act, cure the defect within 15 days; if the application is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the MOEA within 30 days of receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Uniform Number Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (Regional Branch)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the taxpayer registration (税籍登记) on the Integrated Tax Portal within 15 days after the company certificate is issued. Obtain the Taxpayer Uniform Invoice Number, declare the VAT status (generally exempt for securities/financial intermediation), and register the E-invoice capacity if any operational income is expected.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate
Articles of association
Responsible person's identification
Registered-office lease and utility proof
Bank account certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau conducts a physical office inspection and questions the business site, submit a floor plan, tenancy notarization, or utility bills; an administrative review is available under the Tax Collection Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: FSC SPAC Licensing and TPEx Listing Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) - Securities Administration; Taipei Exchange (TPEx)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the SPAC Public Issuance Application (特殊目的收购公司股票公开发行申报) with the FSC and the TPEx SPAC IPO Review Application. Submit the prospectus, sponsor agreement, custodian bank trust-escrow agreement, internal control report, and AML/CFT compliance manual. Obtain the FSC approval letter and TPEx listing clearance before commencing the IPO and depositing funds into the escrow trust account.
required_dossiers: FSC/TPEx SPAC application form and prospectus
Trust-escrow agreement with the custodian bank
CPA report on internal controls over the SPAC fund custodian
Sponsor integrity questionnaire and responsible-person background report
AML/CFT program and sanctions-screening procedures
Legal opinion on the target acquisition framework
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FSC returns the public issuance filing under Article 24 of the Securities and Exchange Act, cure the deficient disclosure, amend the prospectus, and resubmit within 30 days; where the TPEx listing entry is contested, submit the corrected acquisition structure and re-apply after the defect is resolved.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission - Securities Administration and Taipei Exchange (SPAC IPO review); Ministry of Environment - Environmental Protection Administration (environmental clearance); Local Fire Authority (civil defense clearance).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) Securities Public Issuance and TPEx Listing Approval (特殊目的收购公司公开发行及上柜核准函) issued by the FSC and Taipei Exchange.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Environmental Protection Administration (行政院环境部)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category V (office-based fiduciary and financial vehicle; no manufacturing, combustion, or stationary emission source; no full EIA Report required under Article 4 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emissions generated; office premises must connect to the public sewer system per the Sewage Act and comply with municipal effluent SS 30 mg/L, COD 100 mg/L if a private septic system is used; general office waste must be handled under the Waste Management Act; if an emergency generator above 800 kW is installed, the stationary-source standards apply for NOx (150 ppm) and particulate matter (50 ppm).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety equipment inspection and annual fire-safety self-inspection report under the Fire Services Act; Class B-2 office building-use license for the registered address; building structural safety clearance if the office occupies a high-rise building over 16 floors; workplace hazard notification and appointment of an occupational safety supervisor under the Occupational Safety and Health Act; implementation of the FSC internal control and AML compliance procedures for the SPAC custodian and escrow trust operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局), with local tax offices exercising delegated administration; taxpayer service and filing portal is the province-level Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局), accessible via the Internet and the 12366 hotline.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: On incorporation within China, the Administration for Market Regulation issues a business license containing the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which operates as the sole statutory taxpayer identification number (TIN/VAT ID). Registration data is electronically synchronized to the State Taxation Administration, and the WFOE must within thirty days after licensure complete tax registration in the Electronic Tax Bureau, file its accounting policies and bank account information, and activate VAT status (small-scale or general taxpayer). For export activity, separate customs registration and foreign trade operator filing must be completed, together with obtaining a Customs Registration Number and, where applicable, an exporter code, before any zero-rated export transaction may be declared.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China does not provide check-the-box pass-through elections for WFOE limited liability companies; the entity is taxed under Corporate Income Tax (CIT) on its worldwide income as a resident enterprise. Available elections include: (i) voluntary registration as a VAT general taxpayer while annual taxable sales are below the RMB 5 million threshold; (ii) the special election under Article 2 of the CIT Law to treat an offshore-incorporated but Chinese-managed enterprise as a PRC tax resident (relevant to the SPAC advisory or listing holding structure); (iii) quarterly vs. annual CIT prepayment elections, and (iv) the application of treaty or cross-strait double-tax arrangement benefits to reduce dividend or interest withholding. Hybrid mismatch deduction disallowance is addressed through general anti-abuse rules and the CFC and anti-treaty-shopping provisions rather than through statutory elective regimes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) of the People's Republic of China
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 (annual taxable sales) for mandatory registration as a VAT general taxpayer; entities with annual sales below this threshold are registered as small-scale VAT taxpayers unless they elect general taxpayer status. For cross-border or export activities, registration is required regardless of threshold when a WFOE commences outward supplies subject to zero-rating or refund claims.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The nationwide fully digitized electronic invoice system (数字化电子发票) mandates issuance of VAT invoices through the State Taxation Administration's Electronic Invoice Platform, requiring real-time upload of invoice data upon issuance, digital tax control stamps, and automated clearance. Enterprise integrated systems must use the official API or web-service validation to obtain transaction validation codes; paperinvoices are abandoned except in approved transitional cases; VAT special credit invoices and zero-rated export invoices must be annotated in the platform before use and matched with customs export declarations in the Gold Tax interface.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods is eligible for zero-rating where the exporter completes physical customs export procedures, receives and settles foreign exchange within the statutory timeframe, and maintains true and complete documentation, including a valid sales contract and export invoice. Cross-border services, including certain financial and advisory services relevant to a SPAC acquisition vehicle, qualify for zero-rating only when the services are consumed wholly outside China, the service recipient is a non-resident enterprise, and evidence is preserved proving performance, payment receipt in freely convertible currency, and the overseas location of consumption. Untrue or inconsistent documentation will invalidate a zero-rating claim and trigger clawback.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate / Foreign Exchange Settlement Verification
Zero-rated export VAT invoice (digital e-invoice in designated code)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The tax authority will retrospectively repeal zero-rating and claw back requested or obtained VAT refunds where the exporter fails to repatriate and verify foreign exchange proceeds within 180 days from the customs export declaration date, unless a pre-approved extension is granted, or where the customs declarations, bills of lading, or receipts are found fabricated or inconsistent. The clawback is accompanied by a late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the refunded amount plus an administrative penalty between 0.5 and 5 times the tax underpaid. Serious cases involving fraudulent export refunds constitute an offence under Article 204 of the Criminal Law and may attract imprisonment and criminal fines; additionally the exporter may be disqualified from the export refund system and sanctioned via the customs credit management scheme.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, administered under the People's Bank of China (PBoC); Taiwan-source remittance controls are also overseen by the Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (CBC).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is convertible for current-account items (goods, services, and ordinary profit remittances) but is not freely convertible on the capital account. A Taiwan-invested WFOE must receive paid-in capital through a SAFE-registered foreign-exchange capital account; conversion to RMB is permitted only after verification of the actual-use purpose and compliance with the Foreign Investment Negative List. Profit/dividend remittances to the Taiwan shareholder are permissible after audited financial statements, tax clearance, and bank verification, but capital repatriation or an outbound acquisition by the WFOE requires separate SAFE capital-account registration or approval. The Taiwan-side remitter may be subject to CBC declaration or approval for cross-strait FX transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under PRC foreign-exchange regulations, exporters must repatriate export receipts to China, but there is no mandatory cash-surrender ratio or forced conversion percentage. Export proceeds may be retained in a foreign-exchange settlement account or sold on the interbank market. As a general rule, export receipts must be credited to a licensed bank within 90 days from export customs declaration (or the contractually agreed extended payment term with SAFE delayed-remittance reporting), and the bank verifies each receipt against the Trade in Goods Foreign Exchange Monitoring System. Failure to repatriate on time is reported to SAFE and can trigger trade-verification sanctions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account / Capital Escrow Account / RMB Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore fintech electronic-money institutions (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, or Singapore/Hong Kong EMIs) cannot obtain a PRC banking license, cannot open or hold RMB deposits, and cannot clear through CIPS/PBoC rails. They are not a lawful substitute for a domestic bank account of the WFOE, and an escrow arrangement for SPAC acquisition proceeds must remain with a licensed commercial bank or qualified trustee.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Taiwan-invested WFOE, the legal representative (法定代表人) must generally appear physically before the bank, present the original business license and corporate seal/chop, and complete an in-person KYC interview. Remote account opening is only permitted in limited digital account products and not for foreign-exchange capital accounts or high-risk SPAC structures; the Taiwan beneficial owner should prepare a supplementary video interview and notarized apostilled documents. All directors/signatories with account authority must provide valid identity documents and board resolutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Blank-check / SPAC classification: no active operating revenue or commercial substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, SPAC prospectus/offering memorandum, escrow and trust agreements, board resolution approving treasury operations, acquisition pipeline/LOI, and projected fund-flow waterfall.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Taiwan-source ultimate beneficial owner and opaque cross-border ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport/NIC and Taiwan identity documents, UBO chart, tax-residence certificates, source-of-wealth and bank reference letters, signed declarations confirming no OFAC/UN/EU sanctions, CRS/FATCA classifications, and audit trail of intermediate holding vehicles.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border capital injection without completed SAFE FDI registration
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign Investment Information Report (FIIS) code, PRC business license, SAFE Foreign Exchange Business Registration (or bank-generated FDI registration details), capital contribution agreement, joint capital verification report, and board/shareholder investment resolutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large escrow and acquisition disbursements inconsistent with transaction size or economic purpose
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed SPAC/M&A acquisition agreement, target valuation report, regulatory approval letters (MOFCOM/AMR/NDRC/CSRC if applicable), payment schedule, trustee instructions, purpose codes, and evidence of arm's-length pricing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route inbound Taiwan equity through SWIFT MT103 from the Taiwan shareholder to the SAFE-registered Foreign Exchange Capital Account of the WFOE at an authorized bank in China. The instruction must reference the FIIS/FDI registration number, the purpose code for direct investment capital contribution, and the WFOE's exact name and account number. The receiving bank verifies the SAFE registration, UBO/source of funds, negative-list compliance, and sanctions lists before accepting the deposit; funds must be converted into RMB for qualified actual-use purposes. For acquisition or escrow purposes, a segregated Capital Escrow Account may be maintained under a PBOC-approved special-deposit account framework and the applicable escrow/trust agreement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements, use SWIFT MT103 for direct documentary payment, MT700/MT707 for commercial letters of credit, and MT202 COVER for interbank reimbursements. Banks will verify the trade invoice, customs declaration, and Trade in Goods FX Monitoring System and assign the appropriate trade-in-goods purpose code. Capital-account outbound payments (acquisition consideration or outbound M&A) must not travel through the trade rail; they require SAFE registration/approval and must be cleared via an earmarked capital-account or special escrow account using SWIFT MT103/MT202 after issuance of a payment instruction by the board or trustee.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable RMB/USD forward contracts with genuine trade or investment exposure
RMB FX swaps (spot-forward or forward-forward combinations)
Cross-currency swaps for long-term cross-border acquisition financing
Vanilla RMB FX options (OTCs) for non-speculative treasury hedging

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only where SAFE/PBoC has expressly authorized offshore RMB hedging or where the underlying is an offshore RMB exposure; not permissible as a speculative onshore instrument

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Company Report (UBO, Directors, Managers, and ≥10% Shareholder Disclosure)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (Department of Commerce) – Company Registration Information System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: During the month of March each year (by 31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Notification and fine of NTD 10,000–50,000 per violation; repeated non-compliance may lead to suspension or revocation of company registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) – Commercial and Industrial Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year end (by 30 June for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of NTD 30,000–150,000 under the Business Entity Accounting Act; continued refusal may trigger administrative deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Regulatory Report for Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) License
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) – Securities and Futures Bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year end (by 31 March for calendar-year SPACs) or per license condition
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of NTD 240,000–4,800,000 under the Securities and Exchange Act; potential license suspension or revocation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory CPA audit if paid-in capital exceeds NTD 30 million (approx. USD 1 million) or if the company is a licensed financial/SPAC entity regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as endorsed by Taiwan (T-IFRS) for public and SPAC vehicles; local Enterprise Accounting Standards (EAS) for smaller non-public entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: In March each year, file with MOEA a confirmation list of directors, supervisors, managers, and shareholders holding ≥10% ownership. Any interim share transfer must be reflected in the statutory registers and updated in the next annual filing; failure to so results in penalties and potential registration suspension.
